create_qdrant_client: create a multi-tenant Qdrant vector database client with collection prefix and tenant isolation
upsert_vector_items: upsert vector items into a multi-tenant Qdrant collection with automatic collection creation
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vector embeddings in a multi-tenant Qdrant collection with cosine distance
delete_vectors_by_filter: delete vectors from a multi-tenant Qdrant collection by ID or metadata filter with tenant isolation
reset_qdrant_collections: reset the multi-tenant Qdrant database by deleting all collections with the configured prefix
